Interface LocatedHttpRouteScope<T>

Type Parameters:
T - The type of the located target
All Superinterfaces:
HttpRouteScope
All Known Subinterfaces:
LocatedHttpRouteBuilder<T>, LocatedHttpRouteGroup<T>
All Known Implementing Classes:
DefaultLocatedHttpRouteBuilder
public sealed interface LocatedHttpRouteScope<T> extends HttpRouteScope permits LocatedHttpRouteBuilder<T>, LocatedHttpRouteGroup<T>
The declarations of the routes of located targets of a type, see LocatedRoutes, that the LocatedHttpRouteBuilder and its groups, LocatedHttpRouteGroup, have in common: besides the declarations of an HttpRouteScope, routes whose terminals take a handler that receives the target, locators that receive the target, and groups of the routes of the same targets.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

    • locate

      <U> void locate(String prefixUri, LocatedLocatorHandler<T, ? extends U> locator, Function<? super U, ? extends LocatedRoutes<?>> routesOf)
      Route the requests under a prefix to the routes of a target that a locator locates from the located target of these routes, e.g. a child of a node of a tree.
      Type Parameters:
      U - The type of the target the locator locates
      Parameters:
      prefixUri - The URI template of the prefix, relative to the prefix of the locator of these routes
      locator - Locates the target from the target of these routes, or answers null for 404
      routesOf - The routes of a located target
      See Also:
      • HttpRouteScope.locate(String, LocatorHandler, Function)

    • group

      void group(Consumer<LocatedHttpRouteGroup<T>> routes)
      Declare a group of the routes of the located targets, whose filters and settings apply to every route declared in the lambda, see HttpRouteGroup: the group declares the routes of the same targets, so its creators return a LocatedHttpRouteSpec, whose terminals take a handler that receives the target, and its locators receive the target. Its error and status routes are local to its routes. 
      order.group(items -> {
    items.error(NoSuchElementException.class, (request, error) -> HttpResponse.notFound());
    items.GET("/items/{item}").handle((request, pathVariables, order) ->
        HttpResponse.ok(order.item(pathVariables.getInt("item"))));
});
      Parameters:
      routes - Declares the routes and the filters of the group
      See Also:
      • HttpRouteBuilder.group(Consumer)
